CANONICAL_NAME.value: 4.3BSD-Reno TCP (1990) -- fast retransmit and fast recovery

value.lineage: TCP congestion-control lineage, the SUCCESSOR: Reno keeps Tahoe's slow start/avoidance and adds fast retransmit on three duplicate ACKs and fast recovery (halve cwnd instead of collapsing to one segment). 'Reno' is the name later analyses (Fall & Floyd 1996) attach to this behaviour; NewReno, SACK, CUBIC descend from it. Preserved from unix-history-repo tag BSD-4_3_Reno.

value.built_to: recover from a single lost segment without draining the pipe: retransmit on duplicate ACKs and keep sending at half rate
value.pressure: the cost of Tahoe's full slow-start restart on every loss on high bandwidth-delay paths
value.success_means: one loss costs a halving, not a restart; throughput on long fat pipes roughly doubles versus Tahoe

value.failure_condition: multiple losses in one window still collapse it (the NewReno/SACK pressure)

evidence.ref: Fall & Floyd, Simulation-based Comparisons of Tahoe, Reno and SACK TCP, CCR 1996
evidence.says: Reno performs poorly when multiple segments are lost from one window.
Both were standardised specifically to address Reno's behaviour under multiple losses.

environment.note: kernel code; preserved and hashed, not executed

cut.note: the SUCCESSOR in the congestion-control lineage: everything the 4.2BSD cut found (RTT smoothing, backoff, windows, persist, keepalive, delayed ACK, the 500 ms tick) is still here; what is NEW is a congestion window snd_cwnd distinct from the peer's window, opened exponentially below a threshold and linearly above it, reset to one segment on timeout, and (Reno's own addition) a duplicate-ACK counter that retransmits and halves the window without waiting for the timer while keeping the pipe full ('fast recovery')

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.human_name: tcp_input.c 885-900 (cw > ssthresh ? incr = mss^2/cw + mss/8 : incr = mss); tcp_output.c 89 (win = min(snd_wnd, snd_cwnd)); tcp_timer.c 222-229 (reset on timeout)
organs.mechanism: the sender's usable window is the minimum of the receiver's advertisement and a local snd_cwnd; each new ACK adds one segment to cwnd while cwnd < ssthresh (doubling per round trip), and mss^2/cwnd plus mss/8 above it (about one segment per round trip); on a retransmit timeout ssthresh becomes half the window in flight (at least two segments) and cwnd becomes one segment, restarting the exponential phase
assumptions: packet loss signals congestion; the network's capacity is discovered by probing upward and backing off multiplicatively on loss (the AIMD premise)
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the 1986 congestion collapse ended; the sender no longer dumps a full window after a loss
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: loss is the only signal, so the window oscillates around the bottleneck (the sawtooth); the mss/8 term ('to help larger windows open quickly enough') is a tuning constant without derivation
organs.human_prior: Jacobson 1988 'Congestion Avoidance and Control' (the Tahoe algorithms); this file is the Reno release of them
organs.source_boundary: the cwnd arithmetic in the three files

organs.human_name: tcp_input.c 790-855: t_dupacks, tcprexmtthresh = 3, the 'Kludge snd_nxt & the congestion window so we send only this one packet' block, the inflate branch, and the deflate on the next new ACK
organs.mechanism: a pure duplicate ACK (no data, unchanged window, ack == snd_una, retransmit timer running) increments t_dupacks; at exactly three: ssthresh = half the flight (min 2 segments), snd_nxt is pulled back to the acked point, cwnd is set to ONE segment so tcp_output sends exactly the missing segment, then cwnd is set to ssthresh + 3 segments and snd_nxt restored; each further duplicate adds one segment to cwnd and calls tcp_output (new data flows as duplicates confirm departures); the first ACK that advances snd_una deflates cwnd back to ssthresh and zeroes the counter; any non-duplicate resets the counter
organs.output: one retransmission; a temporarily inflated window
assumptions: three duplicates mean a loss rather than reordering (tcprexmtthresh is a global tunable); each duplicate ACK proves one packet left the network, so the window may grow by one without adding load ('packet conservation')
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: a single loss no longer costs a timeout and a slow-start from one segment; throughput on lightly lossy paths roughly doubled (Fall & Floyd 1996 measured the lineage)
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the mechanism assumes one loss per window; two losses in a window leave the second to the timer (the NewReno / SACK problem, not addressed in this body); the deflate to ssthresh on the first new ACK is the 'Reno' step Tahoe lacked
organs.human_prior: Jacobson's 1990 fast recovery (email to end2end-interest); fast retransmit is Tahoe's
organs.source_boundary: the duplicate-ACK block and the deflate lines

organs.mechanism: if the connection is established, the segment has only ACK set, is in sequence, carries the same window and nothing is being retransmitted, then: a zero-length segment whose ACK advances (and cwnd >= snd_wnd, i.e. not in slow start) is handled as a pure ACK (drop acked data, update RTT, restart or stop the timer, wake the writer) and returns; a data segment at the expected ack with an empty reassembly queue and buffer space is appended and a delayed ACK noted; everything else falls through to the full input processing
assumptions: bulk transfer in one direction is the common case; the checks are cheaper than the general path
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: per-packet processing cost cut for the common case (Van Jacobson's 'header prediction')
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the fast path bypasses the cwnd opening, which is why it is guarded by cwnd >= snd_wnd (only when cwnd is no longer the constraint)

rejected_cuts.note: the variance-based RTO (srtt + 4 rttvar) is the one 1983-to-1990 change in the shared organs that this cut did not read; flagged for a DEEP pass

rejected_cuts.evidence: the 1983 cut's nine organs plus these three are separable and were added in two documented steps (Tahoe 1988, Reno 1990)

pressures.source_evidence: tcp_input.c 790-900; tcp_timer.c 147-232; the record's lineage (Fall & Floyd 1996)
pressures.condition: many organisms send through a bottleneck of unknown capacity; the only feedback is ACKs and their absence; a drained pipe costs a round trip of idle capacity; fairness and stability are scored
pressures.resource_or_constraint: the bottleneck's capacity and queue; one RTT of feedback delay
pressures.failure_condition: congestion collapse (goodput falls as load rises), or a single loss costing a timeout-length idle period
pressures.world_punishes: sending the advertised window regardless of loss (4.2BSD); waiting for the timer after a loss (Tahoe without fast retransmit)
pressures.world_rewards: multiplicative decrease on loss, additive increase between losses, retransmission on duplicate-ACK evidence with the window kept full
pressures.observable_consequence: goodput and fairness index of N flows vs offered load, and time-to-recover after a single dropped segment, for the 1983, Tahoe and Reno rules on the same queue
pressures.vacuity_condition: one flow with a known capacity
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: explicit rate signalling from the bottleneck (which the world must withhold)
pressures.cheat_control: an organism told the bottleneck rate must hold it with zero loss; the 1983 rule must collapse under N flows; Tahoe must show the timeout gap on a single loss that Reno closes: the world must show all three
